data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Title
data.value: Connection instructions for the school's super-admin

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Intro
data.value: Hand this text to your school's super-admin. They perform these steps once, in your school's own Google console — outside this program.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Domain.Label
data.value: School domain

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.ClientId.Label
data.value: Service account client ID

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.ClientId.ThisSchoolOnly
data.value: This client ID belongs to your school alone: a neighbouring school has a different one. Do not confuse it with the OAuth web client id an Administrator signs in with.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.NotConfirmed
data.value: not known yet: this installation has not confirmed its legitimacy. The value appears after the first successful check.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Scopes.Label
data.value: The scopes to authorise (every one read-only):

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Step.AuthoriseDelegation
data.value: Authorise domain-wide delegation for this service account: enter the client ID above with the scopes below.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Step.CreateTechnicalAccount
data.value: Create the school's technical account, on whose behalf the program reads the data.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.Label
data.value: What the technical account must be:

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.CreatedBySuperAdmin
data.value: the school's super-admin creates it at onboarding, together with the domain-wide delegation;

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.NoPersonBehindIt
data.value: no person stands behind it, it is not a super-admin, and nobody signs in to the program with it;

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.ReadOnlyRoles
data.value: it must be able to read Classroom and Admin Reports — and hold nothing beyond that;

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.NoWriteAccess
data.value: a super-admin account, and any account with write access, are not acceptable: the program writes nothing to Google Workspace;

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.TechnicalAccount.EnteredInSettings
data.value: an Administrator enters its address in the connection settings, and that address must be in the school's domain.

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Copy.Button
data.value: Copy the instructions

data.name: ConnectionInstruction.Copy.Confirmation
data.value: Instructions copied

data.name: Landing.Settings.ConnectionInstruction
data.value: Connection instructions

data.name: AccessCheck.Title
data.value: Access check

data.name: AccessCheck.Explanation
data.value: The program calls Google as the school's technical account: it requests access for each delegation scope separately and makes one trial read of Classroom and of Admin Reports. Nothing it reads is stored or shown. The same check runs automatically at every start, and its result is written to the application log.

data.name: AccessCheck.Run.Button
data.value: Check access

data.name: AccessCheck.TechnicalAccount.Label
data.value: Technical account

data.name: AccessCheck.Verdict.AccessInPlace
data.value: Access is in place: every check succeeded.

data.name: AccessCheck.Verdict.NotConfigured
data.value: Access is not fully configured — see below what needs to be fixed.

data.name: AccessCheck.Verdict.Inconclusive
data.value: The check could not be completed: Google did not answer. Try again later.

data.name: AccessCheck.Step.ClassroomRead
data.value: Trial read of Google Classroom

data.name: AccessCheck.Step.ReportsRead
data.value: Trial read of Meet events in Admin Reports

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.Succeeded
data.value: works

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.ScopeNotAuthorized
data.value: this scope is not authorised in domain-wide delegation. Ask the school's super-admin to add it for this school's client ID, as the connection instruction says.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.TechnicalAccountUnknown
data.value: the technical account was not found in the school's domain, or it cannot be acted for. Check the address in the connection settings with the school's super-admin.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.TechnicalAccountCannotRead
data.value: access is authorised, but the technical account has no right to this read. The school's super-admin must give it read-only rights to this data.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.ApiNotEnabled
data.value: this API is not enabled in the service Owner's Google Cloud project. The service Owner fixes this, not the school.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.KeyUnavailable
data.value: the service-account key is not available. The service Owner fixes this, not the school.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.KeyRejected
data.value: Google rejected the service-account key. The service Owner fixes this, not the school.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.GoogleUnavailable
data.value: Google did not answer in time or is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.

data.name: AccessCheck.Outcome.NotAttempted
data.value: not checked, because an earlier step prevented it.

data.name: AccessCheck.Refused.NotConfigured
data.value: Save the Google Workspace connection in the connection settings first — there is nothing to check yet.

data.name: AccessCheck.Refused.DomainMismatch
data.value: The saved connection belongs to a domain other than the school's. Save the connection again, then check access.
